messages.body:
You are a RESEARCH agent. Do NOT edit production code. Your job is to analyze the Omni codebase and map out WHERE Sentry should be integrated.

TASK: Read the Omni API codebase and identify ALL integration points for Sentry.

Read these files:
- packages/api/src/index.ts (entry point — where Sentry.init goes)
- packages/api/src/app.ts (Hono app — middleware setup)
- packages/api/src/middleware/error.ts (error handler — where captureException goes)
- packages/api/src/scheduler.ts (scheduled jobs — Sentry Crons integration)
- packages/core/src/ (shared utilities, logger, errors)
- packages/api/src/plugins/ (event listeners, agent dispatcher, etc.)

For each integration point, document:
1. File path and line numbers
2. What Sentry feature applies (error capture, tracing, crons, metrics, breadcrumbs)
3. What data flows through that point (any PII risks?)
4. Recommended integration approach

Also identify:
- Where sensitive data (message content, phone numbers, chat names) flows
- What custom tags/context would be useful (instanceId, channelType, eventType)
- Which scheduled jobs should be monitored with Sentry Crons
- Where custom metrics would add value

Write your findings to /home/genie/agents/namastexlabs/projects/omni/.genie/brainstorms/sentry-mcp/research-codebase-mapping.md

Be EXHAUSTIVE.
